body:
## Sector P / The Caladan plot prices

Compare the published full-payment schedule for Sector P, effective 2 November 2026. The discounted price with plot number starts at PKR 4,190,000 for a 5.56 Marla plot. The table shows the listed prices for all available schedule sizes; request current plot numbers before choosing.

## Check the plot location

Use the Sector P plan to compare road access, plot dimensions and nearby planned open areas. Ask for your shortlisted plot number to be marked on the current plan and confirm its location before booking.

## Registration and location charges

Development charges are included in the plot price. The schedule lists PKR 20,000 registration. Preferred locations may carry additional premiums, so request an itemized quotation for the exact plot.

## Choose a size and request availability

The schedule covers 5.56, 8, 10.89 and 14.22 Marla, 1 Kanal and two 2 Kanal dimensions. Share your preferred size and budget to receive current options, location details and next steps.
